init_intphys_dataset: init a video dataset and dataloader for IntPhys intuitive physics data with configurable batch size and clip length
init_grasp_dataset: init a video dataset and dataloader for grasp evaluation data with property filtering and distributed sampling
init_inflevel_dataset: init a video dataset and dataloader for InFLeV data with optional priming mode and distributed sampling
review_init_data: review the init_data function to understand how it dispatches to IntPhys, Grasp, or InFLeV dataset makers
refactor_init_data: refactor init_data to support additional dataset types beyond IntPhys, Grasp, and InFLeV
